title: HASONEFILTER counts only the filtered values that exist in the column
query: "Red and Purple", CALCULATE ( HASONEFILTER ( Product[Color] ), Product[Color] IN { "Red", "Purple" } ),
"Red and Blue", CALCULATE ( HASONEFILTER ( Product[Color] ), Product[Color] IN { "Red", "Blue" } ) )

source.quote: Filters on non-existing values are not considered
source.supports: the page shows a filter on one existing and one non-existing value returning true, and on two existing values false

derivation: Purple is not a color of Product, so the first filter leaves one filtered value, Red: TRUE. Red and Blue both exist: two filtered values, FALSE.
